label: Slanted Flap 4.0 cm

profile.distinguishingDetail: The slanted flap pocket — also known as the hacking pocket — sets its mouth on a rake, the cut tracing a line from the jacket front edge upward toward the side seam so the pocket sits higher at the back than at the front. The rake has equestrian origins: riders on horseback could reach the pocket without fumbling at the hip. At 4.0 cm the flap is a shallow, restrained depth that keeps the raked line quiet, lying flat against the jacket face along its whole width, its lower edge following the same rake as the mouth above it so the two run parallel, and covering the opening completely from end to end.
